note: Rolling woods, old fields and fishing ponds along Mussel Fork Creek, south of Highway 36 between Brookfield and Bucklin. MDC marks a primitive camping area beside each of the area's ten numbered parking lots, spread over about 5 km of gravel roads; each is a small gravel lot with grass or woods beside it and no pads or facilities. This spot is lot 3 on Route WW at the south end, beside a mown field. Lots 9 and 10 sit just off Highway 36. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: ten map/GIS-designated primitive camping areas, one beside each numbered parking lot (pin = GIS 183 at lot 3 on Route WW). Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual. Phone matches; not waterfront kept. No main camp, no split.
flags: INCLUSION OK: area page 'Things to Do: Camping: Individual Campsites'; brochure 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map'; the map (© 06/14) draws a 'Primitive Camping Area' symbol at each of parking lots 1-10; GIS 27 has ten 'Primitive Camping Area' points. Rule 140 standard; no special-use-only rule, no Rule 101. Each spot is a designated point at a lot edge (the Lick Creek case), so the lot rule does not drop it.

PIN: stored 39.71578,-92.85786 = GIS 183, on the grass edge of a mown field 20 m from lot 781 (map lot 3), a ~12 x 30 m gravel lot on a short gravel spur north off Route WW. Drivable for a 23-ft rig; keep.

CLUSTERS: the ten points are scattered 1.5-4.9 km from the pin, each a single small gravel lot: 181 (lot 2, Noble Drive, the largest lot ~35 x 15 m, beside Pond #4), 182 (lot 4, Abbey Avenue), 184 (lot 7, end of Nepal Road; the GIS point falls in woods by the creek), 185 (lot 8), 186 (lot 6, Nister Road), 187 (lot 5), 188 and 189 (lots 9 and 10, each ~50-100 m off the four-lane Highway 36), 390 (lot 1, west side, a grass field at the end of a two-track). No spot has a privy, pads or a loop; none is a clear main camp. No split proposed: every one is a single small lot (the split rule asks for more than that).

ACCESS: paved Route WW / Highway 36 and gravel county roads (Noble Drive, Nister Road, Abbey Avenue); no low-water crossing on the map, no 4WD wording. Brochure: 'Vehicle use is restricted to graveled and paved roads and established parking areas'.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. Lot 3 looks onto a mown field; Mussel Fork Creek is not in view from it.
HORSES: brochure 'Bicycles and horses allowed on multi-use trails'; no horse camp named.
